## 2. R packages (not redistributed)

The packages listed in `renv.lock` are installed from CRAN by `renv::restore()` and are not part of this repository. Each keeps its own licence; for the locked versions their DESCRIPTION files declare, for example, `rxode2` and `nlmixr2` GPL (>= 3), `expm` and `digest` GPL (>= 2), and `jsonlite` MIT. Nothing here changes those terms, and anyone who distributes a combined work must satisfy them. `renv.lock` records package names, versions, sources and hashes, together with the maintainer details each package publishes.
